rows.label: tlk70000073_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I'd heard His Majesty was gentle and
hated conflict. Quite the strategist,
though. It's almost funny.

rows.label: tlk70000073_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Well, you did save my skin,
so I'm grateful for that.

rows.label: tlk70000073_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Being a spy is dangerous, but the pay
hardly makes it worthwhile. I still
haven't even been paid for this job.

rows.label: tlk70000073_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Either way, it was time to quit. I
don't have any attachment to my
homeland anymore.

rows.label: tlk70000073_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I'll settle into my new life. For now,
I guess I'll practice walking
elegantly in this breezy outfit.
